full_name: Carrie Lambert-Beatty | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2010–2011 Humanities Radcliffe Alumnae Fellow Harvard University
bio: Carrie Lambert-Beatty is an art historian at Harvard University whose research focuses on art since 1960, especially performance art in a broad sense.
